name: Dads
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of fathers in leading and nurturing their families, as seen in Joshua's declaration to serve the LORD as a household (Joshua 24:15) and the call to honor parents for a blessed life (Exodus 20:12). Fathers are to provide instruction and discipline with care, reflecting God’s compassionate heart toward His children (Proverbs 4:1; Psalms 103:13). The responsibility of fathers extends to teaching God's commands diligently (Deuteronomy 6:6) and embracing correction for growth (Proverbs 3:11), highlighting the spiritual and relational duties entrusted to dads.
